title: Lloyds Bank and Bank of Scotland app and online banking outage reported in the UK
date_note: Beinsure's article of 27 November gives no earlier day; it describes the outage as happening on Friday 27 November.
summary: Beinsure reports that Lloyds Bank's mobile app and online banking suffered an outage on Friday 27 November, with Bank of Scotland also disrupted. Lloyds told customers it knew some were having issues logging in and was working to restore services. Beinsure says Lloyds had not disclosed a cause by late Friday morning and gave no estimated recovery time.
plain: Lloyds Bank and Bank of Scotland customers had trouble logging in to the app and online banking on 27 November. Lloyds says it is working to restore service; Beinsure says no cause had been given.
exec: Beinsure reports a Lloyds and Bank of Scotland digital banking outage; Lloyds had not given a cause or recovery time.

validation.note: Single source: Beinsure. Lloyds' own status page and statement were not read.
